You are not just the woman I love…

The woman whose smile can change my entire mood.

The woman I can talk to for hours and still feel like I haven't talked enough.

তুমি মোৰ প্ৰিয় মানুহজনী, মোৰ মৰম, মোৰ কলিজা। 🥹❤️

I love the way you care.
I love the way you smile.
I love your little habits, your little anger, your cute fights, and even those moments when you don't realize how adorable you are.

I don't love you because you're perfect.
I love you because you're YOU. 💗

And if someone ever asks me,
“What is your favourite woman?”
I won't need to think.
I'll simply say:
“My Love… My Pasandida Aurat.” ❤️

My sweetheart.
